concepts.title: Unipotent affine algebraic group
concepts.description: An affine algebraic group that, after extension to an algebraic closure, has a faithful algebraic representation with all matrices upper triangular and every diagonal entry 1.

concepts.title: Unitary operator on a complex Hilbert space
concepts.description: A surjective complex linear map preserving the inner product.

concepts.title: Unitary representation of a topological group
concepts.description: A group homomorphism π from a topological group to the unitary operators of a complex Hilbert space, strongly continuous in the sense that g↦π(g)v is norm-continuous for each vector v.

concepts.title: Universal enveloping algebra of a Lie algebra
concepts.description: The unital associative algebra U(g) with a linear map i:g→U(g) satisfying i([x,y])=i(x)i(y)−i(y)i(x), universal for such maps from g into associative algebras. Its universal property does not include an unproved assertion of injectivity.

concepts.title: Valuation ring of a discretely valued field
concepts.description: For a discrete valuation v on K, the ring O_v={x:v(x)≥0}; its maximal ideal is m_v={x:v(x)>0}.

concepts.title: von Mangoldt function
concepts.description: The arithmetic function Λ(n)=log p if n=p^k for a prime p and integer k≥1, and Λ(n)=0 otherwise.

concepts.title: Weak Jacobi form
concepts.description: An integer-weight, nonnegative integer-index scalar Jacobi form with the usual modular and elliptic transformation laws, whose Fourier expansion at every cusp has n≥0 but may have negative discriminant 4mn−ℓ². This weakens the Fourier-support condition of a holomorphic Jacobi form.

concepts.title: Borel σ-algebra on the real line
concepts.description: The σ-algebra on ℝ generated by the open intervals.

concepts.title: σ-algebra generated by a family of subsets
concepts.description: The smallest σ-algebra containing that family, equivalently the intersection of all σ-algebras on the ambient set that contain it.

concepts.title: Indicator function of a subset
concepts.description: For A⊆Ω, the real function 1_A is 1 on A and 0 on its complement.

concepts.title: Monotonicity of the Lebesgue integral
concepts.description: If 0≤f≤g are measurable functions on a measure space, then ∫f dμ≤∫g dμ, allowing infinite integrals.

concepts.title: Linearity of the Lebesgue integral
concepts.description: If f and g are integrable real functions and a,b are real scalars, then af+bg is integrable and ∫(af+bg)dμ=a∫f dμ+b∫g dμ.

concepts.title: Measurable map between measurable spaces
concepts.description: A function for which the preimage of each measurable subset of the codomain is measurable in the domain.

concepts.title: Measurable simple real function
concepts.description: A measurable real function with finite range. It can be written as a finite sum ∑ a_i 1_{A_i} with measurable level sets A_i.

concepts.title: Measurable space
concepts.description: A set equipped with a specified σ-algebra of subsets.

concepts.title: Divisor of a meromorphic function on a complex manifold
concepts.description: The locally finite formal sum of irreducible complex hypersurfaces weighted by the orders of zeros of a meromorphic function, negative for poles.

concepts.title: Gritsenko–Nikulin’s product for the genus-two weight-five theta product
concepts.description: The genus-two modular form Δ₅, the normalized product of the ten even genus-two theta constants, has product (qrs)^(1/2)∏_(n,l,m)>0(1−qⁿrˡsᵐ)^(f(4nm−l²)), where f is the discriminant coefficient function of φ₀,₁.

concepts.title: Humbert surface in the genus-two Siegel modular variety
concepts.description: The image in Sp₄(Z)∖H₂ of the quadratic divisor a z₁+b z₂+c z₃+d(z₂²−z₁z₃)+e=0 with primitive integer coefficients and positive discriminant D=b²−4ac−4de; all such divisors of discriminant D give the Humbert surface H_D.
